falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on a higher-low structure holding; a break below this level invalidates the structural support thesis and confirms distribution rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 assumes contained volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and regime change to risk-off, breaking the pattern's volatility compression requirement

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts more than -50 basis points (i.e., -0.50% or steeper)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred during curve steepening; deeper inversion signals imminent recession pricing that would override the cyclical bottom narrative

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
